shortDescription: Hugo Boss XETR:BOSS has appointed Frasers LSE:FRAS CEO Michael Murray as the chairman of its supervisory board, the German fashion group said on Wednesday."Hugo Boss is exceptionally well positioned, with two strong brands, a unique global footprint and significant untapped potential," Murray said…

children: CEO Michael Murray as the chairman of its supervisory board, the German fashion group said on Wednesday.
"Hugo Boss is exceptionally well positioned, with two strong brands, a unique global footprint and significant untapped potential," Murray said in a statement.
The company also said Robert Palmer would join the supervisory board, subject to appointment by the local court.
